rules.eligible: post states a held/entered position (long, short, hold, bought) or a preferred direction on a specific tradeable instrument
rules.excluded: purely two-sided/conditional views, general advice, historical trades (already closed or entered before the window), off-topic replies
rules.reiteration: same instrument + direction within 7 days after a scored call: recorded, not scored
rules.pair: explicit two-legged position: legs scored as calls (subject to the reiteration rule) and the pair scored as one equal-weight unit
